name: New Year's Day
why_en: The world welcomes a new year — fresh starts, resolutions, celebration.
why_hi: Duniya naye saal ka swagat karti hai — nayi shuruaat, resolutions, jashn.
who_hi: Duniya bhar ki Gregorian calendar parampara.
fact_en: The earliest New Year parties start in Kiribati's Line Islands.
fact_hi: Sabse pehle New Year Kiribati ke Line Islands me manaya jata hai.

name: World Braille Day
why_en: Honours Louis Braille and promotes reading access for the visually impaired.
why_hi: Louis Braille ka samman aur visually impaired ke liye reading access ka prachaar.
who_hi: United Nations; Braille ke janamdin par.
fact_en: Louis Braille invented his reading system at just 15 years old.
fact_hi: Louis Braille ne sirf 15 saal ki umar me apna reading system invent kiya tha.

name: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas
why_en: Honours the Indian diaspora; marks Gandhi's return to India in 1915.
why_hi: Indian diaspora ka samman; 1915 me Gandhi ki Bharat wapsi ki yaad me.
fact_en: Over 3 crore Indians live abroad — the world's largest diaspora.
fact_hi: 3 crore se zyada Bharatiya videsh me rehte hain — duniya ka sabse bada diaspora.

name: World Hindi Day
why_en: Celebrates Hindi — one of the world's most spoken languages.
why_hi: Hindi ka jashn — duniya ki sabse zyada boli jane wali bhashaon me se ek.
who_en: Government of India; first World Hindi Conference was in 1975.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; pehla World Hindi Conference 1975 me hua tha.
fact_en: Hindi is spoken by over 60 crore people worldwide.
fact_hi: Hindi duniya me 60 crore se zyada log bolte hain.

name: National Youth Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on Swami Vivekananda's birthday, inspiring the youth.
why_hi: Swami Vivekananda ke janamdin par Bharat me — yuvaon ko prerna.
fact_en: Vivekananda's Chicago speech in 1893 began with 'Sisters and brothers of America'.
fact_hi: 1893 me Vivekananda ke Chicago speech ki shuruaat 'Sisters and brothers of America' se hui thi.

name: Lohri
why_en: Punjab's harvest festival — bonfires, peanuts, rewri and folk songs.
why_hi: Punjab ka harvest festival — bonfire, moongfali, rewri aur lokgeet.
who_en: Punjabi tradition marking winter's peak and longer days ahead.
who_hi: Punjabi parampara — sardi ke peak aur lambe dinon ke aagman ki khushi.
fact_en: Lohri is linked to the legend of Dulla Bhatti, Punjab's Robin Hood.
fact_hi: Lohri Dulla Bhatti ki kahani se judi hai — Punjab ke Robin Hood.

name: Makar Sankranti
why_en: Harvest festival marking the sun's journey north — kites fill the sky.
why_hi: Harvest festival — surya ke uttarayan ki khushi, aasmaan patangon se bhar jata hai.
who_en: Ancient Hindu solar tradition, celebrated across India with many names.
who_hi: Prachin Hindu solar parampara, Bharat me kai naamon se manayi jati hai.
fact_en: It's called Pongal in Tamil Nadu, Bihu in Assam, Uttarayan in Gujarat.
fact_hi: Tamil Nadu me Pongal, Assam me Bihu, Gujarat me Uttarayan kehte hain.

name: Indian Army Day
why_en: Honours the Indian Army; marks Lt Gen Cariappa becoming the first Indian Army chief in 1949.
why_hi: Indian Army ka samman; 1949 me Lt Gen Cariappa pehle Indian Army chief bane the.
fact_en: The parade showcases India's military might every year in Delhi.
fact_hi: Har saal Delhi me parade me Bharat ki sainya shakti dikhti hai.

name: Parakram Diwas
why_en: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's birthday — celebrating his courage and the INA.
why_hi: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose ka janamdin — unke sahas aur INA ka jashn.
fact_en: Netaji's slogan 'Tum mujhe khoon do, main tumhe azaadi dunga' still gives goosebumps.
fact_hi: Netaji ka naara 'Tum mujhe khoon do, main tumhe azaadi dunga' aaj bhi rongte khade kar deta hai.

name: National Girl Child Day
why_en: Observed in India to promote girls' rights, education and safety.
why_hi: Bharat me betiyon ke adhikaar, shiksha aur suraksha ka din.
who_en: Government of India, Ministry of Women and Child Development, since 2008.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar, Mahila evam Bal Vikas Mantralaya, 2008 se.
fact_en: Linked to schemes like Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.
fact_hi: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao jaise schemes se juda hai.

name: International Day of Education
why_en: UN's day affirming education as a human right and public good.
why_hi: Shiksha ko manav adhikaar aur public good manne ka UN ka din.
fact_en: About 250 million children worldwide are still out of school.
fact_hi: Duniya me lagbhag 25 crore bacche aaj bhi school se bahar hain.

name: National Voters' Day
why_en: Encourages every Indian to vote; marks the Election Commission's foundation day.
why_hi: Har Bharatiya ko vote ke liye prerit karta hai; Election Commission ke sthapna din par.
fact_en: New voters turning 18 get their voter ID celebrated on this day.
fact_hi: 18 saal ke naye voters ka voter ID isi din celebrate hota hai.

name: National Tourism Day
why_en: Celebrates India's incredible travel destinations and tourism's role in the economy.
why_hi: Bharat ke incredible travel destinations aur economy me tourism ki bhoomika ka jashn.
fact_en: India's tourism tagline 'Incredible India' is famous worldwide.
fact_hi: Bharat ki tourism tagline 'Incredible India' duniya bhar me famous hai.

name: Republic Day
why_en: India's Constitution came into force on this day in 1950 — grand parade at Kartavya Path.
why_hi: 1950 me isi din Bharat ka Samvidhan lagu hua — Kartavya Path par grand parade.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; 1950 se manaya ja raha.
fact_en: The parade's chief guest is always a foreign dignitary.
fact_hi: Parade ke chief guest hamesha koi videshi dignitary hote hain.

name: International Holocaust Remembrance Day
why_en: Honours the six million Jewish victims of the Holocaust and all victims of Nazism.
why_hi: Holocaust ke 60 lakh Jewish peediton aur Nazism ke sabhi shikaaron ki yaad.
who_en: United Nations; marks the 1945 liberation of Auschwitz.
who_hi: United Nations; 1945 me Auschwitz ki mukti ki yaad me.
fact_en: Auschwitz was liberated on 27 January 1945.
fact_hi: 27 January 1945 ko Auschwitz liberate hua tha.

name: Data Privacy Day
why_en: Reminds everyone to protect personal data — passwords, privacy settings, the works.
why_hi: Personal data protect karne ki yaad — passwords, privacy settings, sab kuch.
who_en: Started in Europe as Data Protection Day, 2007; now global.
who_hi: 2007 me Europe me Data Protection Day ke roop me shuru; ab global.
fact_en: It marks the 1981 signing of the first data protection treaty.
fact_hi: 1981 me pehle data protection treaty par sign ki yaad me hai.

name: Martyrs' Day
why_en: India remembers Mahatma Gandhi, assassinated on this day in 1948.
why_hi: Bharat Mahatma Gandhi ko yaad karta hai — 1948 me isi din unki hatya hui thi.
fact_en: A two-minute silence is observed across India at 11 AM.
fact_hi: Subah 11 baje poore Bharat me do minute ka maun rakha jata hai.

name: World Cancer Day
why_en: Unites the world to fight cancer through awareness and early detection.
why_hi: Jagrukta aur early detection se cancer se ladne ke liye duniya ko ekjut karta hai.
who_en: Union for International Cancer Control, since 2000.
who_hi: Union for International Cancer Control, 2000 se.
fact_en: At least one-third of common cancers are preventable.
fact_hi: Kam se kam ek-tihai common cancers roke ja sakte hain.

name: International Day of Women and Girls in Science
why_en: Promotes full participation of women and girls in science.
why_hi: Science me mahilaon aur ladkiyon ki poori bhagidari ka prachaar.
fact_en: Women still make up under a third of researchers worldwide.
fact_hi: Duniya me researchers me mahilayein abhi bhi ek-tihai se kam hain.

name: World Radio Day
why_en: Celebrates radio — still the most trusted and far-reaching medium.
why_hi: Radio ka jashn — aaj bhi sabse trusted aur door tak pahunchne wala medium.
who_en: UNESCO; marks UN Radio's first broadcast in 1946.
who_hi: UNESCO; 1946 me UN Radio ke pehle broadcast ki yaad me.
fact_en: Radio reaches more people than any other medium on Earth.
fact_hi: Radio dharti par kisi bhi aur medium se zyada logon tak pahunchta hai.

name: Valentine's Day
why_en: The global day of love — roses, chocolates and grand gestures.
why_hi: Pyaar ka global din — gulab, chocolates aur grand gestures.
who_en: Named after Saint Valentine; popularised in the 1800s.
who_hi: Saint Valentine ke naam par; 1800s me popular hua.
fact_en: Around 1 billion Valentine's cards are exchanged every year.
fact_hi: Har saal lagbhag 1 billion Valentine's cards exchange hote hain.

name: International Mother Language Day
why_en: Promotes linguistic diversity; honours the 1952 Bengali language martyrs.
why_hi: Bhashaon ki vividhata ka prachaar; 1952 ke Bengali bhasha shaheedon ki yaad me.
fact_en: Over 7,000 languages are spoken in the world — many are endangered.
fact_hi: Duniya me 7,000 se zyada bhashayein boli jati hain — kai khatre me hain.

name: National Science Day
why_en: Celebrated in India marking C.V. Raman's discovery of the Raman Effect in 1928.
why_hi: 1928 me C.V. Raman ki Raman Effect ki khoj ki yaad me Bharat me manaya jata hai.
fact_en: Raman won the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics — Asia's first science Nobel.
fact_hi: Raman ne 1930 ka Physics Nobel jeeta — Asia ka pehla science Nobel.

name: World Wildlife Day
why_en: Celebrates wild animals and plants and fights wildlife crime.
why_hi: Jangli janwaron aur paudhon ka jashn aur wildlife crime ke khilaaf ladai.
who_en: United Nations; marks the 1973 CITES convention signing.
who_hi: United Nations; 1973 ke CITES convention signing ki yaad me.
fact_en: India's Project Tiger (1973) helped tigers bounce back from under 2,000.
fact_hi: Bharat ke Project Tiger (1973) ne 2,000 se kam baghon ko wapas badhaya.

name: International Women's Day
why_en: Celebrates women's achievements and pushes for gender equality.
why_hi: Mahilaon ki uplabdhiyon ka jashn aur gender equality ki appeal.
fact_en: The UN's first theme in 1996 was 'Celebrating the Past, Planning for the Future'.
fact_hi: 1996 me UN ka pehla theme tha 'Celebrating the Past, Planning for the Future'.

name: Pi Day
why_en: Math nerds celebrate π (3.14) on 3/14 — with actual pie, obviously.
why_hi: Math ke deewane π (3.14) ka jashn 3/14 ko manate hain — obviously pie ke saath.
fact_en: It's also Albert Einstein's birthday.
fact_hi: Ye Albert Einstein ka janamdin bhi hai.

name: World Consumer Rights Day
why_en: Asserts that every consumer deserves safety, information and choice.
why_hi: Har consumer ko safety, suchna aur choice ka adhikaar dilane ka din.
who_en: Consumers International; inspired by JFK's 1962 speech.
who_hi: Consumers International; 1962 me JFK ke speech se prerit.
fact_en: JFK was the first world leader to formally address consumer rights.
fact_hi: JFK pehle world leader the jinhone consumer rights par formally bola.

name: International Day of Happiness
why_en: The UN's day reminding us that happiness is a fundamental human goal.
why_hi: UN ka din jo yaad dilata hai ki khushi ek fundamental human goal hai.
who_en: United Nations, proposed by Bhutan, since 2013.
who_hi: United Nations, Bhutan ke prastaav par, 2013 se.
fact_en: Bhutan measures Gross National Happiness instead of just GDP.
fact_hi: Bhutan sirf GDP nahi, Gross National Happiness measure karta hai.

name: International Day of Forests
why_en: Celebrates forests — lungs of the Earth — and fights deforestation.
why_hi: Jangalon ka jashn — dharti ke lungs — aur deforestation ke khilaaf.
fact_en: Forests cover 31% of Earth's land and host 80% of land biodiversity.
fact_hi: Jangal dharti ke 31% land par hain aur 80% land biodiversity ka ghar.

name: World Water Day
why_en: Highlights that 2 billion people still lack safe drinking water.
why_hi: Dikhata hai ki 2 billion logon ke paas aaj bhi safe drinking water nahi.
fact_en: The average person needs 50–100 litres of water a day for basic needs.
fact_hi: Basic needs ke liye ek vyakti ko roz 50–100 litre paani chahiye.

name: World Meteorological Day
why_en: Marks the founding of the World Meteorological Organization in 1950.
why_hi: 1950 me World Meteorological Organization ki sthapna ki yaad me.
fact_en: Modern 5-day weather forecasts are as accurate as 1-day forecasts were in 1980.
fact_hi: Aaj ke 5-day forecasts utne accurate hain jitne 1980 me 1-day forecasts the.

name: April Fools' Day
why_en: The world's official prank day — trust nothing you read today.
why_hi: Duniya ka official prank day — aaj jo padho uspe bharosa mat karo.
who_hi: Origin par debate hai; 1700s se popular.
fact_en: Big brands now plan elaborate April Fools' campaigns every year.
fact_hi: Bade brands har saal elaborate April Fools' campaigns plan karte hain.

name: World Autism Awareness Day
why_en: Promotes understanding and acceptance of autistic people.
why_hi: Autistic logon ke liye samajh aur sweekriti ka prachaar.
fact_en: Landmarks light up blue as part of 'Light It Up Blue'.
fact_hi: 'Light It Up Blue' me famous buildings neele rang me jagmagati hain.

name: World Health Day
why_en: Marks the founding of WHO in 1948 and campaigns for health for all.
why_hi: 1948 me WHO ki sthapna ki yaad aur sabke liye sehat ka abhiyan.
fact_en: Each year WHO picks a theme — recent ones covered health workers.
fact_hi: Har saal WHO ek theme chunta hai — recent themes health workers par the.

name: Ambedkar Jayanti
why_en: Honours Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, architect of India's Constitution, on his birthday.
why_hi: Bharat ke Samvidhan ke architect Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ke janamdin par samman.
fact_en: Ambedkar earned doctorates from Columbia University and LSE.
fact_hi: Ambedkar ne Columbia University aur LSE se doctorates haasil kiye.

name: World Heritage Day
why_en: Celebrates cultural heritage — monuments, sites and traditions worth protecting.
why_hi: Sanskritik virasat ka jashn — monuments, sites aur paramparayein jinhe bachana hai.
fact_en: India has 40+ UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
fact_hi: Bharat me 40+ UNESCO World Heritage Sites hain.

name: Earth Day
why_en: The world's largest environmental movement — 1 billion people take part.
why_hi: Duniya ka sabse bada environmental movement — 1 billion log hissa lete hain.
who_en: Started by US Senator Gaylord Nelson in 1970.
who_hi: 1970 me US Senator Gaylord Nelson ne shuru kiya.
fact_en: Earth Day 1970 mobilised 20 million Americans — 10% of the population then.
fact_hi: 1970 ke Earth Day ne 2 crore Americans ko joda — tab ki 10% population.

name: World Book Day
why_en: Celebrates books and reading — also the death anniversary of Shakespeare.
why_hi: Kitabon aur reading ka jashn — Shakespeare ki death anniversary bhi.
fact_en: In Catalonia, it's tradition to gift a book and a rose on this day.
fact_hi: Catalonia me is din kitab aur gulab gift karne ki parampara hai.

name: World Malaria Day
why_en: Fights malaria, which still kills over 6 lakh people a year.
why_hi: Malaria ke khilaaf ladai, jo aaj bhi saal me 6 lakh se zyada jaan leti hai.
fact_en: India aims to eliminate malaria by 2030.
fact_hi: Bharat ka lakshya 2030 tak malaria khatam karna hai.

name: International Labour Day
why_en: Honours workers and the labour movement worldwide.
why_hi: Duniya bhar me workers aur labour movement ka samman.
who_en: Rooted in the 1886 Haymarket affair, Chicago.
who_hi: Jad 1886 ke Haymarket affair, Chicago me.
fact_en: It's a public holiday in 80+ countries.
fact_hi: 80+ deshon me public holiday hai.

name: World Press Freedom Day
why_en: Defends the freedom of the press and honours journalists killed on duty.
why_hi: Press ki azadi ki raksha aur duty par shaheed journalists ka samman.
fact_en: UNESCO gives the Guillermo Cano Press Freedom Prize on this day.
fact_hi: UNESCO is din Guillermo Cano Press Freedom Prize deta hai.

name: Star Wars Day
why_en: 'May the Fourth be with you' — the global day for Star Wars fans.
why_hi: 'May the Fourth be with you' — Star Wars fans ka global din.
who_en: Fans; the pun made it inevitable. Disney officially embraced it.
who_hi: Fans; ye pun to hona hi tha. Disney ne officially apna liya.
fact_en: The first organised celebration was in Toronto in 2011.
fact_hi: Pehla organised celebration 2011 me Toronto me hua tha.

name: World Red Cross Day
why_en: Honours Henry Dunant, founder of the Red Cross, on his birthday.
why_hi: Red Cross ke founder Henry Dunant ke janamdin par samman.
fact_en: The Red Cross operates in nearly every country on Earth.
fact_hi: Red Cross dharti ke lagbhag har desh me kaam karta hai.

name: International Nurses Day
why_en: Honours nurses worldwide on Florence Nightingale's birthday.
why_hi: Florence Nightingale ke janamdin par duniya bhar ki nurses ka samman.
fact_en: Nightingale was called 'The Lady with the Lamp' in the Crimean War.
fact_hi: Crimean War me Nightingale ko 'The Lady with the Lamp' kehte the.

name: International Day of Families
why_en: Celebrates families in all their forms around the world.
why_hi: Duniya bhar me har roop ke parivaron ka jashn.
fact_en: The UN picks a new family-focused theme every year.
fact_hi: UN har saal family par ek naya theme chunta hai.

name: World Telecommunication Day
why_en: Marks the founding of the International Telecommunication Union in 1865.
why_hi: 1865 me International Telecommunication Union ki sthapna ki yaad me.
fact_en: The ITU is one of the oldest international organisations — older than the telephone's popularity.
fact_hi: ITU sabse purani international organisations me se ek hai.

name: International Museum Day
why_en: Celebrates museums — many offer free entry on this day.
why_hi: Museums ka jashn — kai is din free entry dete hain.
fact_en: There are about 55,000 museums in the world.
fact_hi: Duniya me lagbhag 55,000 museums hain.

name: World No Tobacco Day
why_en: WHO's campaign highlighting tobacco's deadly toll — 8 million deaths a year.
why_hi: WHO ka abhiyan — tobacco se saal me 80 lakh mautein.
fact_en: Tobacco kills 8 million people a year — more than malaria, TB and AIDS combined.
fact_hi: Tobacco se saal me 80 lakh mautein — malaria, TB aur AIDS teenon se zyada.

name: World Environment Day
why_en: The UN's biggest day for the planet — hosted by a different country each year.
why_hi: Planet ke liye UN ka sabse bada din — har saal alag desh host karta hai.
fact_en: India hosted it in 2018 with the theme 'Beat Plastic Pollution'.
fact_hi: 2018 me Bharat ne host kiya tha — theme tha 'Beat Plastic Pollution'.

name: World Oceans Day
why_en: Celebrates oceans covering 70% of Earth and fights plastic pollution.
why_hi: Dharti ke 70% hisse par oceans ka jashn aur plastic pollution ke khilaaf.
fact_en: Oceans produce over half the oxygen we breathe.
fact_hi: Hum jo oxygen lete hain uska aadhe se zyada oceans dete hain.

name: World Day Against Child Labour
why_en: Fights child labour — 160 million children are still affected.
why_hi: Child labour ke khilaaf — 16 crore bacche aaj bhi affected hain.
fact_en: The UN wants child labour ended in all its forms by 2025 — the push continues.
fact_hi: UN har roop ke child labour ko khatam karna chahta hai — koshish jaari hai.

name: World Blood Donor Day
why_en: Thanks voluntary blood donors and encourages more to donate.
why_hi: Voluntary blood donors ka dhanyavaad aur aur logon ko donate ke liye prerna.
who_en: WHO; on Karl Landsteiner's birthday (blood group discoverer).
who_hi: WHO; Karl Landsteiner (blood group khojkarta) ke janamdin par.
fact_en: One donation can save up to three lives.
fact_hi: Ek donation se teen zindagiyan bach sakti hain.

name: International Yoga Day
why_en: Celebrates yoga — India's gift to the world — on the longest day of the year.
why_hi: Yoga ka jashn — Bharat ki duniya ko den — saal ke sabse lambe din par.
who_en: United Nations, proposed by PM Modi, since 2015.
who_hi: United Nations, PM Modi ke prastaav par, 2015 se.
fact_en: The first Yoga Day set two Guinness records — 35,985 people at Rajpath.
fact_hi: Pehle Yoga Day ne do Guinness records banaye — Rajpath par 35,985 log.

name: World Music Day
why_en: Celebrates music with free concerts everywhere — play, listen, vibe.
why_hi: Har jagah free concerts ke saath music ka jashn — bajao, suno, vibe karo.
who_en: Started in France as Fête de la Musique, 1982.
who_hi: 1982 me France me Fête de la Musique ke roop me shuru.
fact_en: Over 120 countries now celebrate it.
fact_hi: Ab 120+ desh ise manate hain.

name: International Day Against Drug Abuse
why_en: UN's day against drug abuse and illicit trafficking.
why_hi: Drug abuse aur illegal trafficking ke khilaaf UN ka din.
fact_en: Its slogan 'Share Facts On Drugs, Save Lives' fights myths with science.
fact_hi: Iska slogan 'Share Facts On Drugs, Save Lives' science se myths ko harata hai.

name: National Doctors' Day
why_en: Observed in India on Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy's birthday, honouring doctors.
why_hi: Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy ke janamdin par Bharat me doctors ka samman.
fact_en: Dr. Roy was both a legendary physician and West Bengal's Chief Minister.
fact_hi: Dr. Roy legendary physician bhi the aur West Bengal ke CM bhi.

name: World Chocolate Day
why_en: Celebrates chocolate — marking its introduction to Europe in 1550.
why_hi: Chocolate ka jashn — 1550 me Europe me iski entry ki yaad me.
who_hi: Duniya bhar ke chocolate lovers; 1550 ki date.
fact_en: Dark chocolate has actual health benefits — in moderation.
fact_hi: Dark chocolate me real health benefits hain — moderation me.

name: World Population Day
why_en: Focuses on population issues — the world hit 8 billion in 2022.
why_hi: Population issues par focus — 2022 me duniya 8 billion ho gayi.
fact_en: India overtook China as the most populous country in 2023.
fact_hi: 2023 me Bharat China ko peeche chhod sabse zyada population wala desh bana.

name: World Emoji Day
why_en: Celebrates the tiny pictures that run our chats — on 📅's date in Apple calendar.
why_hi: Un chhoti pictures ka jashn jo hamari chats chalati hain — Apple calendar me 📅 ki date par.
who_en: Founded by Jeremy Burge of Emojipedia in 2014.
who_hi: 2014 me Emojipedia ke Jeremy Burge ne shuru kiya.
fact_en: Apple and Google reveal new emojis around this day.
fact_hi: Apple aur Google is din ke aas-paas naye emojis reveal karte hain.

name: Nelson Mandela Day
why_en: Honours Mandela — spend 67 minutes helping others, for his 67 years of service.
why_hi: Mandela ka samman — unke 67 saalon ki seva ke liye 67 minute doosron ki madad me.
who_hi: United Nations, Mandela ke janamdin par.
fact_en: Mandela spent 27 years in prison before becoming South Africa's president.
fact_hi: Mandela president banne se pehle 27 saal jail me rahe.

name: World Hepatitis Day
why_en: Fights hepatitis — 300+ million people live with it unknowingly.
why_hi: Hepatitis ke khilaaf — 30 crore+ log anjane me iske saath jee rahe hain.
who_en: WHO; on Dr. Baruch Blumberg's birthday (hepatitis B discoverer).
who_hi: WHO; Dr. Baruch Blumberg (hepatitis B khojkarta) ke janamdin par.
fact_en: Hepatitis B was the first cancer-preventing vaccine — it stops liver cancer.
fact_hi: Hepatitis B pehli cancer-rokne wali vaccine thi — liver cancer rokti hai.

name: International Tiger Day
why_en: Fights to double wild tiger numbers — a goal set in 2010.
why_hi: Jangli baghon ki sankhya double karne ka lakshya — 2010 me set.
fact_en: India is home to about 75% of the world's wild tigers.
fact_hi: Duniya ke lagbhag 75% jangli bagh Bharat me hain.

name: World Wide Web Day
why_en: Celebrates the public birth of the web — Tim Berners-Lee's gift to humanity.
why_hi: Web ke public janm ka jashn — Tim Berners-Lee ka insaniyat ko tohfa.
who_en: Tech community; web went public in 1991.
who_hi: Tech community; 1991 me web public hua.
fact_en: The first website is still online at CERN.
fact_hi: Pehli website aaj bhi CERN par online hai.

name: International Youth Day
why_en: Celebrates young people as partners in change.
why_hi: Yuvaon ka jashn — change ke partners ke roop me.
fact_en: Half the world's population is under 30 — this day is literally about the majority.
fact_hi: Duniya ki aadhi population 30 se kam umar ki hai — ye din literally majority ka hai.

name: Independence Day
why_en: India's freedom from British rule in 1947 — flag hoisting at Red Fort.
why_hi: 1947 me British shasan se Bharat ki azadi — Red Fort par flag hoisting.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; 1947 se manaya ja raha.
fact_en: Nehru's 'Tryst with Destiny' speech was delivered at midnight on 14–15 August 1947.
fact_hi: Nehru ka 'Tryst with Destiny' speech 14–15 August 1947 ki midnight ko diya gaya tha.

name: World Photography Day
why_en: Celebrates photography — on the date the daguerreotype was gifted to the world in 1839.
why_hi: Photography ka jashn — 1839 me daguerreotype duniya ko gift ki date par.
who_hi: Photography community; 19 August 1839 ki yaad me.
fact_en: The first selfie was taken in 1839 — by Robert Cornelius.
fact_hi: Pehli selfie 1839 me li gayi thi — Robert Cornelius ne.

name: World Humanitarian Day
why_en: Honours aid workers — marks the 2003 Baghdad bombing that killed 22 humanitarians.
why_hi: Aid workers ka samman — 2003 Baghdad bombing ki yaad me jisme 22 humanitarians shaheed hue.
fact_en: Hundreds of aid workers risk their lives in conflict zones every year.
fact_hi: Saikdon aid workers har saal conflict zones me apni jaan jokhim me daalte hain.

name: Women's Equality Day
why_en: Marks American women winning the vote in 1920 and pushes for full equality.
why_hi: 1920 me American mahilaon ko vote ka adhikaar milne ki yaad aur poori equality ki appeal.
fact_en: The 19th Amendment was certified on 26 August 1920 after decades of struggle.
fact_hi: Decades ke sangharsh ke baad 26 August 1920 ko 19th Amendment certify hua.

name: National Sports Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on hockey legend Dhyan Chand's birthday.
why_hi: Hockey legend Dhyan Chand ke janamdin par Bharat me manaya jata hai.
fact_en: Dhyan Chand scored 400+ goals and won 3 Olympic golds.
fact_hi: Dhyan Chand ne 400+ goals kiye aur 3 Olympic gold jeete.

name: Teachers' Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan's birthday, honouring teachers.
why_hi: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan ke janamdin par Bharat me teachers ka samman.
fact_en: Radhakrishnan said his birthday should be observed as Teachers' Day.
fact_hi: Radhakrishnan ne khud kaha tha ki unka janamdin Teachers' Day ke roop me manaya jaye.

name: International Day of Charity
why_en: Promotes charity and volunteering, on Mother Teresa's death anniversary.
why_hi: Daan aur volunteering ka prachaar — Mother Teresa ki death anniversary par.
fact_en: Mother Teresa won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979 for her humanitarian work.
fact_hi: Mother Teresa ne 1979 me humanitarian work ke liye Nobel Peace Prize jeeta.

name: International Literacy Day
why_en: Fights illiteracy — 750 million adults still can't read or write.
why_hi: Illiteracy ke khilaaf — 75 crore adults aaj bhi padh-likh nahi sakte.
fact_en: UNESCO gives Literacy Prizes on this day to the best programs worldwide.
fact_hi: UNESCO is din duniya ke best programs ko Literacy Prizes deta hai.

name: World Suicide Prevention Day
why_en: Raises awareness that suicide is preventable — and help is always available.
why_hi: Jagrukta ki suicide roka ja sakta hai — aur madad hamesha available hai.
fact_en: India's helpline: 14416 (Tele-MANAS) — free, 24x7.
fact_hi: Bharat ki helpline: 14416 (Tele-MANAS) — free, 24x7.

name: Hindi Diwas
why_en: Celebrates Hindi — adopted as an official language of India on this day in 1949.
why_hi: Hindi ka jashn — 1949 me isi din Bharat ki official bhasha bani.
fact_en: Hindi Diwas is different from World Hindi Day (10 January).
fact_hi: Hindi Diwas (14 Sep) World Hindi Day (10 Jan) se alag hai.

name: International Day of Democracy
why_en: Celebrates democracy as a universal value.
why_hi: Democracy ka jashn — ek universal value ke roop me.
fact_en: India is the world's largest democracy — with 90+ crore eligible voters.
fact_hi: Bharat duniya ka sabse bada democracy hai — 90 crore+ eligible voters.

name: Engineers' Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on M. Visvesvaraya's birthday, honouring engineers.
why_hi: M. Visvesvaraya ke janamdin par Bharat me engineers ka samman.
fact_en: Visvesvaraya designed the Krishna Raja Sagara dam in Mysore.
fact_hi: Visvesvaraya ne Mysore me Krishna Raja Sagara dam design kiya tha.

name: World Ozone Day
why_en: Marks the 1987 Montreal Protocol — the most successful environmental treaty ever.
why_hi: 1987 ke Montreal Protocol ki yaad — sabse successful environmental treaty.
fact_en: The ozone hole is slowly healing thanks to this treaty.
fact_hi: Is treaty ki wajah se ozone hole dheere-dheere heal ho raha hai.

name: International Day of Peace
why_en: The UN's day of global ceasefire and non-violence.
why_hi: Global ceasefire aur non-violence ka UN ka din.
fact_en: The Peace Bell at UN HQ is rung on this day.
fact_hi: Is din UN HQ me Peace Bell bajayi jati hai.

name: World Tourism Day
why_en: Celebrates travel and tourism's power to connect cultures.
why_hi: Travel aur tourism ka jashn — Sanskritiyon ko jodne ki taakat.
fact_en: Tourism is 10% of global GDP and employs 1 in 10 people.
fact_hi: Tourism global GDP ka 10% hai aur 10 me se 1 ko rozgar deta hai.

name: World Rabies Day
why_en: Fights rabies — 99% of cases come from dog bites, yet it's vaccine-preventable.
why_hi: Rabies ke khilaaf — 99% cases kutte ke kaatne se, phir bhi vaccine se roka ja sakta hai.
who_en: Global Alliance for Rabies Control; on Louis Pasteur's death anniversary.
who_hi: Global Alliance for Rabies Control; Louis Pasteur ki death anniversary par.
fact_en: India runs one of the world's largest free anti-rabies programs.
fact_hi: Bharat duniya ke sabse bade free anti-rabies programs me se ek chalata hai.

name: World Heart Day
why_en: Fights cardiovascular disease — the world's number one killer.
why_hi: Cardiovascular disease ke khilaaf — duniya ka number one killer.
fact_en: 80% of premature heart disease is preventable with healthy habits.
fact_hi: 80% premature heart disease healthy habits se roki ja sakti hai.

name: World Arthritis Day
why_en: Raises awareness about arthritis — 350 million people live with it worldwide.
why_hi: Arthritis ke baare me jagrukta — duniya me 35 crore log iske saath jeete hain.
fact_en: Arthritis isn't just an 'old people's' disease — kids get it too.
fact_hi: Arthritis sirf 'buddhon ki' bimari nahi — bacchon ko bhi hoti hai.

name: International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction
why_en: To build a global culture of disaster preparedness and reduce risks from floods, quakes and cyclones.
why_hi: Baadh, bhukamp, toofan jaise aapdaon se bachne ke liye duniya bhar me taiyaari ki sanskriti banana.
who_en: United Nations General Assembly — permanent date fixed as 13 October in 2009.
who_hi: United Nations General Assembly — 2009 me 13 October fix date banaya gaya.
fact_en: 2026 theme: 'Resilience Starts at Home' — safer homes, safer families.
fact_hi: 2026 ka theme: 'Resilience Starts at Home' — surakshit ghar, surakshit parivaar.

name: International Day for Failure
why_en: To remove the shame around failure and celebrate learning from mistakes.
why_hi: Failure ki sharm khatam karke galtiyon se seekhne ka jashn manana.
who_en: Students of Aalto University, Finland — first celebrated in 2010.
who_hi: Finland ki Aalto University ke students — pehli baar 2010 me manaya.
fact_en: By 2012 the idea had already spread to 17 countries.
fact_hi: 2012 tak ye idea 17 deshon me fail chuka tha.

name: International Skeptics Day
why_en: An unofficial day to question everything and celebrate evidence-based thinking.
why_hi: Har cheez pe sawal uthane aur saboot wali soch ka unofficial din.
who_en: Origin unknown — fittingly skeptical about its own history.
who_hi: Origin pata nahi — apne hi itihaas pe skeptical, fitting hai.
fact_en: Motto in spirit: don't believe it till you verify it.
fact_hi: Spirit me motto: verify kiye bina believe mat karo.

name: International Suit Up Day
why_en: A day to dress sharp like Barney Stinson from 'How I Met Your Mother'.
why_hi: 'How I Met Your Mother' ke Barney Stinson ki tarah dapper dress-up ka din.
who_hi: Sitcom ke fans, lagbhag 2009–2010 me shuru.
fact_en: Barney's catchphrase 'Suit up!' became the day's slogan.
fact_hi: Barney ka dialogue 'Suit up!' is din ka slogan ban gaya.

name: Ada Lovelace Day
why_en: Celebrates women in STEM, honouring Ada Lovelace who wrote the first computer program in 1843.
why_hi: STEM me women ka jashn — Ada Lovelace ke naam, jinhone 1843 me pehla computer program likha tha.
who_en: Founded by Suw Charman-Anderson in 2009; held every second Tuesday of October.
who_hi: 2009 me Suw Charman-Anderson ne shuru kiya; har saal October ke dusre Tuesday ko.
fact_en: Ada's notes on the Analytical Engine are called the first algorithm.
fact_hi: Analytical Engine par Ada ke notes ko pehla algorithm kehte hain.

name: International Plain Language Day
why_en: Promotes writing that is clear, simple and easy for everyone to understand.
why_hi: Aisi simple bhasha ka prachaar jo har koi aasani se samajh sake.
who_hi: Duniya bhar ke plain-language supporters; 2011 se manaya ja raha.
fact_en: Born from the fight against confusing legal and government jargon.
fact_hi: Confusing kanooni-sarkaari bhasha ke khilaaf ladai se paida hua.

name: World Standards Day
why_en: Honours the experts who create international standards that keep products safe and compatible.
why_hi: Un experts ka samman jo international standards banate hain taaki products safe aur compatible rahen.
who_en: ISO, IEC and ITU — first celebrated in 1970.
who_hi: ISO, IEC aur ITU — pehli baar 1970 me manaya gaya.
fact_en: Without standards, your phone charger wouldn't fit any phone.
fact_hi: Standards na hote to tumhara charger kisi phone me fit hi na hota.

name: National Dessert Day
why_en: A delicious excuse (from the US) to eat dessert first and ask questions later.
why_hi: Meetha khane ka official bahana — pehle dessert, sawal baad me.
who_en: Started in the United States as a food-holiday celebration.
who_hi: America me food-holiday ke roop me shuru hua.
fact_en: The average person eats dessert about 3 times a week — today, make it 4.
fact_hi: Aaj extra meetha banta hai, calorie count kal dekh lena.

name: Global Handwashing Day
why_en: Reminds the world that washing hands with soap is one of the cheapest lifesavers.
why_hi: Yaad dilata hai ki sabun se haath dhona sabse sasta life-saver hai.
who_en: Global Handwashing Partnership; endorsed by UN agencies, first held in 2008.
who_hi: Global Handwashing Partnership; UN agencies ka support, pehli baar 2008 me.
fact_en: Handwashing with soap can cut diarrhoeal disease by about 40%.
fact_hi: Sabun se haath dhone se pet ki bimaariyan lagbhag 40% kam ho sakti hain.

name: World Students' Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam's birthday to honour students and learning.
why_hi: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam ke janamdin par Bharat me students aur seekhne ka samman.
who_en: Declared by the United Nations in 2010 in Kalam's honour.
who_hi: 2010 me United Nations ne Kalam ke samman me ghoshit kiya.
fact_en: Kalam called students 'the ignited minds' of the nation.
fact_hi: Kalam students ko desh ke 'ignited minds' kehte the.

name: World Food Day
why_en: Fights world hunger and promotes food security for all.
why_hi: Duniya se bhook mitane aur sabke liye food security ka din.
who_en: UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), founded on this date in 1945.
who_hi: UN ka Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) — isi date 1945 me bana tha.
fact_en: Over 150 countries take part in World Food Day events every year.
fact_hi: Har saal 150+ desh World Food Day me hissa lete hain.

name: Boss's Day
why_en: A day to appreciate the boss — or at least survive them with a smile.
why_hi: Boss ki tareef ka din — ya kam se kam smile ke saath survive karne ka.
who_en: Started in the US in 1958 by Patricia Bays Haroski for her own boss.
who_hi: 1958 me America me Patricia Bays Haroski ne apne boss ke liye shuru kiya.
fact_en: It began as one employee's idea and became a global office tradition.
fact_hi: Ek employee ke idea se shuru hokar global office tradition ban gaya.

name: International Day for the Eradication of Poverty
why_en: Honours victims of poverty and calls for action to end it everywhere.
why_hi: Gareebi ke shikaaron ka samman aur ise khatam karne ki appeal.
who_en: United Nations; first observed in 1993, rooted in a 1987 Paris gathering.
who_hi: United Nations; pehli baar 1993 me, jad 1987 ke Paris gathering me.
fact_en: The 1987 gathering honoured victims of hunger and violence in Paris.
fact_hi: 1987 me Paris me bhookh aur hinsa ke shikaaron ko shraddhanjali di gayi thi.

name: World Menopause Day
why_en: Raises awareness about menopause and support for women's health.
why_hi: Menopause ke baare me jagrukta aur women's health support ka din.
fact_en: By 2030, over 1.2 billion women worldwide will be menopausal or postmenopausal.
fact_hi: 2030 tak duniya me 1.2 billion se zyada mahilayein is stage me hongi.

name: World Osteoporosis Day
why_en: Highlights bone health and prevention of fractures from weak bones.
why_hi: Haddiyon ki sehat aur kamzor haddi se fracture se bachav ka din.
fact_en: One in 3 women over 50 will suffer an osteoporotic fracture.
fact_hi: 50 se upar ki 3 me se 1 mahila ko aisa fracture hota hai.

name: Global Iodine Deficiency Disorders Prevention Day
why_en: Promotes iodised salt to prevent brain-development disorders in children.
why_hi: Bacchon ke dimaag ke vikas ke liye iodised namak ka prachaar.
who_en: Global health bodies with WHO support; observed every 21 October.
who_hi: WHO ke support se global health bodies; har 21 October ko.
fact_en: Iodine deficiency is the world's most preventable cause of brain damage.
fact_hi: Iodine ki kami duniya me dimaagi nuksan ka sabse rokne-yogya kaaran hai.

name: International Stuttering Awareness Day
why_en: Supports people who stutter and fights the stigma around it.
why_hi: Haklane walon ka support aur isse judi stigma khatam karne ka din.
who_hi: Duniya bhar ki stuttering associations; 1998 se manaya ja raha.
fact_en: Around 80 million people worldwide stutter — about 1% of us.
fact_hi: Duniya me lagbhag 8 crore log haklate hain — lagbhag 1%.

name: Mole Day
why_en: A nerdy chemistry party celebrating Avogadro's number 6.02×10²³ — on 10/23, 6:02 AM to 6:02 PM.
why_hi: Chemistry ke deewanon ka din — Avogadro number 6.02×10²³ ke naam, 10/23 ko subah 6:02 se shaam 6:02 tak.
who_en: Inspired by a 1980s article in The Science Teacher magazine.
who_hi: 1980s me The Science Teacher magazine ke ek article se prerit.
fact_en: A mole of moles (the animal) would cover Earth in a layer miles deep.
fact_hi: Ek mole chuhe poori dharti ko kai km gehri parat se dhak denge.

name: United Nations Day
why_en: Marks the anniversary of the UN Charter coming into force in 1945.
why_hi: 1945 me UN Charter lagu hone ki anniversary.
who_hi: United Nations; 1948 se manaya ja raha.
fact_en: The UN started with 51 member states — today it has 193.
fact_hi: UN 51 member deshon se shuru hua tha — aaj 193 hain.

name: World Polio Day
why_en: Marks the fight to eradicate polio, honouring Jonas Salk who made the first polio vaccine.
why_hi: Polio khatam karne ki ladai ka din — Jonas Salk ke naam, jinhone pehli polio vaccine banayi.
who_en: Rotary International; held on Salk's birthday.
who_hi: Rotary International; Salk ke janamdin par manaya jata hai.
fact_en: Polio cases have fallen over 99% since 1988.
fact_hi: 1988 se polio cases 99% se zyada kam ho gaye hain.

name: World Pasta Day
why_en: Celebrates pasta — the world's most loved comfort food — with 40 pasta producers meeting in Rome in 1995.
why_hi: Pasta ka jashn — duniya ka favourite comfort food; 1995 me Rome me 40 pasta producers mile the.
fact_en: There are over 600 known pasta shapes worldwide.
fact_hi: Duniya me 600 se zyada pasta shapes hain.

name: World Day for Audiovisual Heritage
why_en: UNESCO's day to preserve films, recordings and broadcasts before they decay.
why_hi: UNESCO ka din — films, recordings aur broadcasts ko kharab hone se pehle bachana.
fact_en: Old film reels literally rot — archives race to digitise them.
fact_hi: Purani film reels sach me sad jaati hain — archive unhe digitise karne ki race me hain.

name: International Animation Day
why_en: Celebrates the art of animation on the anniversary of the first public animated screening in 1892.
why_hi: 1892 me pehli public animated screening ki anniversary par animation art ka jashn.
fact_en: Émile Reynaud projected moving drawings in Paris — before cinema was born.
fact_hi: Émile Reynaud ne Paris me chalti-phirti drawings dikhayi thi — cinema ke janm se pehle.

name: World Stroke Day
why_en: Raises awareness that strokes are preventable and treatable if acted on fast.
why_hi: Jagrukta ki stroke roka ja sakta hai aur turant action se ilaj sambhav hai.
fact_en: Remember FAST: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty — Time to call emergency.
fact_hi: FAST yaad rakho: Face tedha, Arm kamzor, Speech gadbad — turant emergency call.

name: International Internet Day
why_en: Celebrates the first ever message sent over ARPANET in 1969 — the internet's birthday.
why_hi: 1969 me ARPANET par bheje gaye pehle message ka jashn — internet ka birthday.
who_hi: Tech community; 29 October 1969 ki yaad me.
fact_en: The first message was supposed to be 'LOGIN' — the system crashed after 'LO'.
fact_hi: Pehla message 'LOGIN' hona tha — system 'LO' ke baad crash ho gaya.

name: Halloween
why_en: Costumes, candy and spooky fun — rooted in the ancient Celtic festival of Samhain.
why_hi: Costumes, candy aur spooky masti — jad prachin Celtic tyohar Samhain me.
who_en: Celtic origins, Ireland; popularised in America in the 1800s.
who_hi: Celtic origins, Ireland; 1800s me America me popular hua.
fact_en: 'Trick or treat' comes from medieval souling traditions.
fact_hi: 'Trick or treat' medieval souling parampara se aaya hai.

name: World Savings Day
why_en: Promotes the habit of saving money, started by banks after World War I.
why_hi: Paise bachane ki aadat ka prachaar — World War I ke baad banks ne shuru kiya.
who_en: World Society of Savings Banks, Milan 1924.
who_hi: World Society of Savings Banks, Milan 1924.
fact_en: It was created to rebuild public trust in banks after the war.
fact_hi: Yuddh ke baad banks par bharosa wapas lane ke liye banaya gaya tha.

name: World Vegan Day
why_en: Celebrates the vegan lifestyle and its benefits for animals, health and planet.
why_hi: Vegan lifestyle ka jashn — janwaron, sehat aur planet ke fayde ke liye.
who_en: The Vegan Society, UK — coined 'vegan' in 1944, day since 1994.
who_hi: The Vegan Society, UK — 1944 me 'vegan' shabd banaya, 1994 se ye din.
fact_en: The word 'vegan' was coined by Donald Watson in 1944.
fact_hi: 'Vegan' shabd 1944 me Donald Watson ne banaya tha.

name: World Tsunami Awareness Day
why_en: Promotes tsunami preparedness, proposed by Japan after the 2011 disaster.
why_hi: Tsunami taiyaari ka prachaar — 2011 ki tragedy ke baad Japan ke prastaav par.
fact_en: The date honours a Japanese story of a villager who saved his people with fire signals in 1854.
fact_hi: Ye date 1854 ki ek Japanese kahani ke naam — ek gaon wale ne aag ke isharon se sabko bachaya tha.

name: National Cancer Awareness Day
why_en: Observed in India to spread awareness about early detection of cancer.
why_hi: Bharat me cancer ki early detection ke liye jagrukta din.
who_en: Government of India; marks the birth anniversary of Marie Curie.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; Marie Curie ke janamdin par.
fact_en: Marie Curie won Nobel Prizes in two different sciences — physics and chemistry.
fact_hi: Marie Curie ne do alag sciences me Nobel jeete — physics aur chemistry.

name: Diwali — Festival of Lights
why_en: India's biggest festival — victory of light over darkness, with Lakshmi Puja on this night in 2026.
why_hi: Bharat ka sabse bada tyohar — andher par roshni ki jeet; 2026 me isi raat Lakshmi Puja.
who_en: Ancient Hindu tradition marking Lord Rama's return to Ayodhya.
who_hi: Prachin Hindu parampara — Bhagwan Ram ki Ayodhya wapsi ki khushi me.
fact_en: Diwali 2026's five days run 6–10 November; main Lakshmi Puja on 8 November.
fact_hi: 2026 me Diwali ke paanch din 6–10 November; mukhya Lakshmi Puja 8 November ko.

name: World Radiography Day
why_en: Marks the discovery of X-rays in 1895 and honours radiographers.
why_hi: 1895 me X-ray ki khoj ki yaad aur radiographers ka samman.
who_en: Radiology societies worldwide; date of Röntgen's discovery.
who_hi: Duniya bhar ki radiology societies; Röntgen ki khoj ki date.
fact_en: Röntgen's first X-ray image was of his wife's hand — wedding ring and all.
fact_hi: Röntgen ki pehli X-ray image unki patni ke haath ki thi — wedding ring samet.

name: National Legal Services Day
why_en: Observed in India to spread awareness about free legal aid for all.
why_hi: Bharat me sabke liye muft kanooni madad ki jagrukta ka din.
who_en: NALSA; marks the Legal Services Authorities Act coming into force in 1995.
who_hi: NALSA; 1995 me Legal Services Authorities Act lagu hone ki yaad me.
fact_en: Lok Adalats have settled crores of cases without long court battles.
fact_hi: Lok Adalat lambi kanooni ladai ke bina karodon cases suljha chuki hai.

name: World Science Day for Peace and Development
why_en: Shows how science serves peace, development and everyday life.
why_hi: Dikhata hai ki science shanti, vikas aur roz ki zindagi me kaise kaam aati hai.
fact_en: Each year UNESCO picks a theme — recent ones covered trust in science.
fact_hi: Har saal UNESCO ek theme chunta hai — recent themes science par bharose pe the.

name: National Education Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on Maulana Abul Kalam Azad's birthday, honouring education.
why_hi: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ke janamdin par Bharat me shiksha ka samman.
who_en: Government of India; Azad was India's first Education Minister.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; Azad Bharat ke pehle Shiksha Mantri the.
fact_en: Azad founded IITs' predecessor institutions and championed free primary education.
fact_hi: Azad ne IITs ki neev wali sansthaon ki sthapna ki aur muft primary shiksha ki wakalat ki.

name: Singles' Day
why_en: The world's biggest shopping festival — started as an anti-Valentine's day for singles in China.
why_hi: Duniya ka sabse bada shopping festival — China me singles ke anti-Valentine's ke roop me shuru.
who_en: Nanjing University students, 1993; Alibaba turned it into a sales mega-event in 2009.
who_hi: Nanjing University ke students, 1993; 2009 me Alibaba ne ise mega-sale bana diya.
fact_en: Singles' Day sales dwarf Black Friday and Cyber Monday combined.
fact_hi: Singles' Day ki sales Black Friday + Cyber Monday dono ko peeche chhod deti hai.

name: World Pneumonia Day
why_en: Fights the world's biggest infectious killer of children under five.
why_hi: Paanch saal se chhote bacchon ke sabse bade sankramak hatyare ke khilaaf.
who_en: Global Coalition Against Child Pneumonia, since 2009.
who_hi: Global Coalition Against Child Pneumonia, 2009 se.
fact_en: Pneumonia kills more children than any other infectious disease.
fact_hi: Pneumonia kisi bhi aur sankramak bimari se zyada bacchon ki jaan leta hai.

name: World Kindness Day
why_en: A day to be deliberately kind — small acts, big ripples.
why_hi: Jaan-boojhkar dayaalu banne ka din — chhote kaam, bade asar.
who_en: World Kindness Movement, launched in Tokyo 1997; day since 1998.
who_hi: World Kindness Movement, 1997 Tokyo me launch; 1998 se ye din.
fact_en: It started from a Tokyo conference of kindness organisations.
fact_hi: Tokyo me kindness organisations ke ek conference se shuru hua tha.

name: World Diabetes Day
why_en: The world's largest diabetes awareness campaign, on insulin co-discoverer Banting's birthday.
why_hi: Duniya ka sabse bada diabetes jagrukta abhiyan — insulin ke khojkarta Banting ke janamdin par.
who_en: International Diabetes Federation and WHO, since 1991; UN-recognised since 2006.
who_hi: International Diabetes Federation aur WHO, 1991 se; 2006 se UN-recognised.
fact_en: The blue circle is the global symbol of diabetes awareness.
fact_hi: Neela circle diabetes jagrukta ka global symbol hai.

name: Children's Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on Jawaharlal Nehru's birthday — 'Chacha Nehru' loved children.
why_hi: Jawaharlal Nehru ke janamdin par Bharat me — 'Chacha Nehru' bacchon se bahut pyaar karte the.
who_en: Government of India; Nehru's birthday, 14 November.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; Nehru ka janamdin, 14 November.
fact_en: Nehru's rose-in-the-coat look became iconic partly because of children pinning roses on him.
fact_hi: Nehru ke coat me gulab ka look iconic bana — bacche unhe gulab lagate the.

name: International Day for Tolerance
why_en: Promotes respect and acceptance among cultures, religions and peoples.
why_hi: Sanskritiyon, dharmon aur logon ke beech samman aur sweekriti ka prachaar.
who_en: UNESCO; declared by the UN in 1996.
who_hi: UNESCO; 1996 me UN ne ghoshit kiya.
fact_en: It followed UNESCO's 1995 Year for Tolerance.
fact_hi: Ye UNESCO ke 1995 'Year for Tolerance' ke baad aaya.

name: National Press Day
why_en: Observed in India marking the Press Council of India starting work in 1966.
why_hi: Bharat me Press Council of India ke 1966 me kaam shuru karne ki yaad me.
fact_en: The Press Council guards press freedom and ethics in India.
fact_hi: Press Council Bharat me press ki azadi aur ethics ki raksha karta hai.

name: International Students' Day
why_en: Honours student activism — rooted in the 1939 Nazi storming of Czech universities.
why_hi: Student activism ka samman — jad 1939 me Czech universities par Nazi hamle me.
fact_en: It began as a memorial to students killed and imprisoned in Prague in 1939.
fact_hi: 1939 me Prague me maare gaye aur kaid students ki yaad me shuru hua tha.

name: World Toilet Day
why_en: Yes, really — the UN's day to tackle the global sanitation crisis.
why_hi: Haan, sach me — global sanitation crisis se ladne ka UN ka din.
who_en: United Nations; first proposed by Singapore's World Toilet Organization.
who_hi: United Nations; pehle Singapore ke World Toilet Organization ne prastaav diya.
fact_en: Billions still lack safe toilets — this day pushes governments to act.
fact_hi: Arabon ke paas aaj bhi safe toilet nahi — ye din sarkaron ko action ke liye push karta hai.

name: International Men's Day
why_en: Highlights men's health, positive role models and gender equality for all.
why_hi: Men's health, positive role models aur sabke liye gender equality ka din.
who_en: Revived by Jerome Teelucksingh in Trinidad and Tobago, 1999.
who_hi: 1999 me Trinidad and Tobago ke Jerome Teelucksingh ne dobara shuru kiya.
fact_en: Themes often cover mental health and fatherhood.
fact_hi: Themes aksar mental health aur fatherhood par hote hain.

name: World Children's Day
why_en: UNICEF's day promoting children's rights worldwide.
why_hi: Duniya bhar me bacchon ke adhikaaron ka UNICEF ka din.
who_en: United Nations; marks the 1989 Convention on the Rights of the Child.
who_hi: United Nations; 1989 ke Child Rights Convention ki yaad me.
fact_en: Landmarks worldwide light up blue for this day — #GoBlue.
fact_hi: Is din duniya bhar ki famous buildings neeli roshni me jagmagati hain — #GoBlue.

name: World Television Day
why_en: Recognises TV's role in informing and connecting the world.
why_hi: Duniya ko jodne aur suchna dene me TV ki bhoomika ka samman.
fact_en: Philo Farnsworth invented electronic TV at age 21.
fact_hi: Philo Farnsworth ne 21 saal ki umar me electronic TV invent kiya tha.

name: International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women
why_en: Honours the Mirabal sisters and fights violence against women globally.
why_hi: Mirabal behno ki yaad aur mahilaon ke khilaaf hinsa ke khilaaf ladai.
who_en: United Nations, since 1999; date marks the 1960 assassination of the Mirabal sisters.
who_hi: United Nations, 1999 se; 1960 me Mirabal behno ki hatya ki date.
fact_en: It kicks off 16 Days of Activism ending on Human Rights Day, 10 December.
fact_hi: Isse 16 Days of Activism shuru hote hain jo 10 December Human Rights Day par khatam hote hain.

name: Constitution Day
why_en: India's Samvidhan Diwas — the Constitution was adopted on this day in 1949.
why_hi: Bharat ka Samvidhan Diwas — 1949 me isi din Samvidhan apnaya gaya tha.
who_en: Government of India; declared in 2015 for Ambedkar's 125th birth anniversary.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; 2015 me Ambedkar ki 125vi jayanti par ghoshit.
fact_en: India's Constitution is the world's longest written constitution.
fact_hi: Bharat ka Samvidhan duniya ka sabse lamba likhit samvidhan hai.

name: National Milk Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on Dr. Verghese Kurien's birthday — the father of the White Revolution.
why_hi: Dr. Verghese Kurien ke janamdin par — White Revolution ke janak ke naam.
fact_en: Kurien's Amul model made India the world's largest milk producer.
fact_hi: Kurien ke Amul model ne Bharat ko duniya ka sabse bada doodh utpadak banaya.

name: Thanksgiving
why_en: America's day of gratitude, feasts and family — always the fourth Thursday of November.
why_hi: America ka shukrana din — feast aur family; har saal November ka chautha Thursday.
who_en: US tradition dating to 1621; made a federal holiday by Lincoln in 1863.
who_hi: 1621 se US parampara; 1863 me Lincoln ne federal holiday banaya.
fact_en: Americans eat around 46 million turkeys every Thanksgiving.
fact_hi: Har Thanksgiving Americans lagbhag 4.6 crore turkey kha jate hain.

name: International Day of Solidarity with the Palestinian People
why_en: UN's day calling for Palestinian rights and peaceful resolution.
why_hi: Palestinian adhikaaron aur shantipurn samadhan ki UN ki appeal ka din.
fact_en: The date marks the 1947 UN partition plan resolution.
fact_hi: Ye date 1947 ke UN partition plan resolution ki yaad me hai.

name: World AIDS Day
why_en: The first-ever global health day, uniting the fight against HIV/AIDS.
why_hi: Pehla global health day — HIV/AIDS ke khilaaf ekjut ladai.
fact_en: The red ribbon became its symbol in 1991.
fact_hi: 1991 me red ribbon iska symbol bana.

name: International Day for the Abolition of Slavery
why_en: Marks the 1949 UN convention against human trafficking and modern slavery.
why_hi: 1949 ke UN convention ki yaad — human trafficking aur modern slavery ke khilaaf.
fact_en: Modern slavery still traps an estimated 50 million people.
fact_hi: Aaj bhi lagbhag 5 crore log modern slavery me fanse hain.

name: National Pollution Control Day
why_en: Observed in India in memory of the 1984 Bhopal gas tragedy victims.
why_hi: 1984 Bhopal gas tragedy ke peediton ki yaad me Bharat me manaya jata hai.
fact_en: The Bhopal tragedy remains one of the world's worst industrial disasters.
fact_hi: Bhopal tragedy duniya ki sabse badi industrial disasters me se ek hai.

name: International Day of Persons with Disabilities
why_en: Promotes the rights and inclusion of persons with disabilities.
why_hi: Divyangjan ke adhikaaron aur samavesh ka prachaar.
fact_en: Over 1 billion people — 1 in 6 of us — live with significant disability.
fact_hi: 1 billion se zyada log — hum me se 6 me se 1 — disability ke saath jeete hain.

name: Indian Navy Day
why_en: Honours the Indian Navy's daring Karachi harbour attack in the 1971 war.
why_hi: 1971 yuddh me Karachi harbour par Navy ke daring hamle ka samman.
who_en: Indian Navy; marks Operation Trident, 4 December 1971.
who_hi: Indian Navy; Operation Trident, 4 December 1971 ki yaad me.
fact_en: Operation Trident sank Pakistani naval vessels without a single Indian casualty.
fact_hi: Operation Trident me bina ek bhi Indian casualty Pakistani jahaaz doob gaye.

name: World Soil Day
why_en: Celebrates healthy soil — 95% of our food grows in it.
why_hi: Healthy mitti ka jashn — hamara 95% khana isi me ugta hai.
who_en: UN Food and Agriculture Organization, since 2014.
who_hi: UN Food and Agriculture Organization, 2014 se.
fact_en: One teaspoon of soil holds more microorganisms than people on Earth.
fact_hi: Ek chammach mitti me dharti ke logon se zyada microorganisms hote hain.

name: Armed Forces Flag Day
why_en: India honours its soldiers; citizens donate to the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund.
why_hi: Bharat apne sainikon ka samman karta hai; nagrik Flag Day Fund me daan dete hain.
fact_en: The fund supports welfare of war widows, ex-servicemen and their families.
fact_hi: Ye fund veer nariyon, ex-servicemen aur unke parivaron ke kalyan ke liye hai.

name: International Civil Aviation Day
why_en: Celebrates aviation's role in connecting the world, on ICAO's founding date.
why_hi: Duniya ko jodne me aviation ki bhoomika ka jashn — ICAO ke sthapna din par.
who_hi: ICAO/United Nations; ICAO ki sthapna 7 December 1944.
fact_en: Over 4 billion passengers fly every year — double the number from a decade ago.
fact_hi: Har saal 4 billion se zyada passengers udte hain — ek decade pehle se double.

name: International Anti-Corruption Day
why_en: Unites the world against corruption, marking the UN anti-corruption convention.
why_hi: Bhrashtachar ke khilaaf duniya ko ekjut karta hai — UN convention ki yaad me.
fact_en: Corruption costs developing countries an estimated $1.26 trillion a year.
fact_hi: Bhrashtachar se developing deshon ko saal me lagbhag $1.26 trillion ka nuksan.

name: Human Rights Day
why_en: Marks the 1948 adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
why_hi: 1948 me Universal Declaration of Human Rights apnaye jane ki yaad me.
fact_en: The UDHR is the most translated document in the world — 500+ languages.
fact_hi: UDHR duniya ka sabse zyada translated document hai — 500+ bhashayein.

name: International Mountain Day
why_en: Celebrates mountains — home to 15% of humanity and our freshwater towers.
why_hi: Pahadon ka jashn — 15% insaniyat ka ghar aur hamare freshwater towers.
fact_en: Mountains supply freshwater to half of humanity.
fact_hi: Pahad aadhi insaniyat ko meetha paani dete hain.

name: National Energy Conservation Day
why_en: Observed in India to promote saving energy and fighting climate change.
why_hi: Bharat me energy bachane aur climate change se ladne ka din.
who_en: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Government of India.
who_hi: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Bharat Sarkar.
fact_en: National awards honour India's most energy-efficient industries.
fact_hi: Sabse energy-efficient industries ko national awards milte hain.

name: International Tea Day
why_en: Celebrates tea — the world's most loved drink after water.
why_hi: Chai ka jashn — paani ke baad duniya ka sabse loved drink.
who_en: United Nations; moved to 15 December in 2020.
who_hi: United Nations; 2020 me 15 December par shift hua.
fact_en: India is the world's second-largest tea producer.
fact_hi: Bharat duniya ka dusra sabse bada chai utpadak hai.

name: Vijay Diwas
why_en: India celebrates its 1971 victory over Pakistan and the birth of Bangladesh.
why_hi: 1971 me Pakistan par jeet aur Bangladesh ke janm ka Bharat ka jashn.
who_hi: Bharat Sarkar; 16 December 1971 ki yaad me.
fact_en: Over 93,000 Pakistani soldiers surrendered — the largest surrender since WWII.
fact_hi: 93,000 se zyada Pakistani sainikon ne surrender kiya — WWII ke baad sabse bada.

name: International Migrants Day
why_en: Honours the contributions of 280+ million migrants worldwide.
why_hi: Duniya bhar ke 28 crore+ migrants ke yogdaan ka samman.
fact_en: If migrants formed a country, it would be the world's fourth most populous.
fact_hi: Agar migrants ek desh hote to duniya ka chautha sabse bada desh hota.

name: Minorities Rights Day
why_en: Observed in India to protect the rights of religious minorities.
why_hi: Bharat me dharmik alpasankhyakon ke adhikaaron ki raksha ka din.
fact_en: India's Constitution guarantees minorities the right to run their own institutions.
fact_hi: Bharat ka Samvidhan alpasankhyakon ko apne institutions chalane ka adhikaar deta hai.

name: Goa Liberation Day
why_en: Celebrates Goa's freedom from Portuguese rule in 1961.
why_hi: 1961 me Portuguese shasan se Goa ki mukti ka jashn.
who_hi: Goa Sarkar; 19 December 1961 ki yaad me.
fact_en: Goa was under Portuguese rule for 451 years.
fact_hi: Goa 451 saalon tak Portuguese shasan me raha.

name: International Human Solidarity Day
why_en: Celebrates unity in diversity and reminds governments to honour global commitments.
why_hi: Vividhata me ekta ka jashn aur sarkaron ko global commitments ki yaad.
fact_en: Solidarity is one of the UN's core values — this day celebrates it.
fact_hi: Solidarity UN ke core values me se ek hai — ye din usi ka jashn hai.

name: Winter Solstice
why_en: The shortest day and longest night of the year in the Northern Hemisphere.
why_hi: Northern Hemisphere me saal ka sabse chhota din aur sabse lambi raat.
who_en: Astronomy — Earth's tilt does the magic.
who_hi: Astronomy — dharti ke jhukav ka kamaal.
fact_en: After this, days start getting longer again — light returns.
fact_hi: Iske baad din phir lambe hone lagte hain — roshni wapas aati hai.

name: National Mathematics Day
why_en: Celebrated in India on Srinivasa Ramanujan's birthday, the math genius.
why_hi: Math genius Srinivasa Ramanujan ke janamdin par Bharat me manaya jata hai.
fact_en: Ramanujan wrote nearly 3,900 mathematical results with almost no formal training.
fact_hi: Ramanujan ne bina formal training ke lagbhag 3,900 mathematical results likhe.

name: Kisan Diwas
why_en: India's Farmers' Day on Chaudhary Charan Singh's birthday, honouring annadatas.
why_hi: Chaudhary Charan Singh ke janamdin par Bharat ka Kisan Diwas — annadaton ka samman.
fact_en: Charan Singh was India's fifth Prime Minister and a lifelong farmer leader.
fact_hi: Charan Singh Bharat ke paanchve Pradhan Mantri aur lifelong kisan neta the.

name: Christmas Eve
why_en: The magical night before Christmas — gifts, carols and midnight cheer.
why_hi: Christmas se pehli jadui raat — gifts, carols aur midnight masti.
fact_en: NORAD 'tracks' Santa every Christmas Eve — a tradition since 1955.
fact_hi: NORAD har Christmas Eve 'Santa track' karta hai — 1955 se parampara hai.

name: National Consumer Rights Day
why_en: Observed in India marking the Consumer Protection Act, 1986.
why_hi: Bharat me Consumer Protection Act, 1986 ki yaad me manaya jata hai.
fact_en: Remember: 'Jago Grahak Jago' — you can complain at e-daakhil online.
fact_hi: Yaad rakho: 'Jago Grahak Jago' — e-daakhil par online complaint kar sakte ho.

name: Christmas Day
why_en: Celebrates the birth of Jesus Christ — trees, feasts and joy worldwide.
why_hi: Jesus Christ ke janm ka jashn — trees, feast aur duniya bhar me khushi.
who_en: Christian tradition; a public holiday in 160+ countries.
who_hi: Christian parampara; 160+ deshon me public holiday.
fact_en: 'Xmas' isn't disrespectful — X is the Greek letter Chi, for Christ.
fact_hi: 'Xmas' disrespectful nahi hai — X Greek letter Chi hai, Christ ke liye.

name: Good Governance Day
why_en: Observed in India on Atal Bihari Vajpayee's birthday, promoting accountable governance.
why_hi: Atal Bihari Vajpayee ke janamdin par Bharat me — jawabdeh shasan ka prachaar.
fact_en: Vajpayee was the first non-Congress PM to complete a full 5-year term.
fact_hi: Vajpayee pehle non-Congress PM the jinhone poora 5-saal ka term complete kiya.

name: Boxing Day
why_en: A day of leftovers, sales and football — born from the tradition of giving boxes to the poor.
why_hi: Leftovers, sales aur football ka din — gareebon ko boxes dene ki parampara se paida.
who_en: British tradition, now in Commonwealth countries.
who_hi: British parampara, ab Commonwealth deshon me.
fact_en: The biggest shopping sales in the UK happen on Boxing Day.
fact_hi: UK me sabse badi shopping sales Boxing Day par hoti hain.

name: Veer Bal Diwas
why_en: Honours the martyrdom of Guru Gobind Singh's young sons, the Sahibzadas.
why_hi: Guru Gobind Singh ke chhote Sahibzadon ki shahadat ka samman.
fact_en: The Sahibzadas, aged 6 and 9, chose faith over life.
fact_hi: 6 aur 9 saal ke Sahibzadon ne jaan se upar dharm chuna.

name: New Year's Eve
why_en: The world counts down to midnight — parties, fireworks and resolutions.
why_hi: Duniya midnight ka countdown karti hai — parties, fireworks aur resolutions.
who_en: Global tradition on the Gregorian calendar.
fact_en: Sydney is among the first major cities to welcome the New Year.
fact_hi: Sydney New Year manane wale pehle bade shehron me se ek hai.
